query:
INSERT INTO mailbox.messages (message_uuid, to_session_id, from_session_id, body)
                   SELECT gen_random_uuid(), m.from_session_id, NULL,
                          '[mike mail] Not delivered: your message ' || m.message_uuid::text
                          || ' to session ' || recip.session_uuid::text
                          || ' was given up on (' || $2::text
                          || '). mike delivers it again when that session next makes a request.'
                     FROM mailbox.messages m
                     JOIN sessions.sessions recip ON recip.id = m.to_session_id
                    WHERE m.message_uuid = $1
                      AND m.from_session_id IS NOT NULL
                      AND m.consumed_at IS NULL
                      AND NOT EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM mailbox.messages n
                           WHERE n.to_session_id = m.from_session_id
                             AND n.body LIKE $3)
                RETURNING message_uuid AS "message_uuid!"
